title_sq: Ne Fillim Te Bulevardit Te Ri Tek Kompleksi Novus, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Me Verande!!!
description_sq: Ne fillim te Bulevardit te Ri tek Kompleksi Novus, Shitet Apartament 2+1 me verande ne katin e 7 banim. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe totale 106.6m² , ku siperfaqe neto 68.4m², verande 25.9 m² dhe te perbashketa 12.3m². Organizohet ne korridor, sallonin e ndenjes, kendin e gatimit dhe ngrenies me dalje ne verande, dhoma e gjumit matrimoniale me tualetin e perfshire ,dhoma tjeter e gjumit dhe nje tualet tjeter dite. Cdo ambient ka dalje ne verande. Orientohet jug-perendim duke pasur ndricim te bollshem natyral gjate gjithe dites. Kompleksi ku ndodhet eshte ne fazen perfundimtare dhe dallohet per cilesi te larte punimesh. Fasada do jete e ventiluar dhe e veshur me panel alumini. Izolimi i mureve me dopio tullë dhe lesh guri në mes. Dritaret jane termike dhe akustike me dopio xham. Planimetri funksionale. Rifiniturat e brëndshme shumë cilësore. Siguri dhe mirëmbajtje 24 orë.
title_en: At the beginning of the new boulevard at Novus complex, 2+1 apartment with veranda for sale!!!
description_en: At the beginning of the New Boulevard at the Novus Complex, 2+1 apartment for sale with a veranda on the 7th residential floor. The apartment has a total area of ​​106.6 m², where the net area is 68.4 m², veranda 25.9 m² and common area 12.3 m². It is organized in the corridor, the living room, the kitchen and dining area with exit to the veranda, the matrimonial bedroom with the toilet included, another bedroom and another day toilet. Every room has an exit to the veranda. It is oriented south-west, having abundant natural light throughout the day. The complex where it is located is in the final stage and stands out for the high quality of works. The facade will be ventilated and covered with aluminum panels. Insulation of the walls with double brick and stone wool in between. The windows are thermal and acoustic with double glazing. Functional layout. High quality interior finishes. 24 hour security and maintenance.
